# Test fixtures

- `OptiScaler-0.9.4.ini` — the `OptiScaler.ini` of the OptiScaler 0.9.4
  release, byte for byte (a test checks it against the SHA-256 pinned in
  `src/package.rs`). OptiScaler is GPL-3.0 (https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler);
  it's here so the settings tests run against the file Tatu actually edits.
